note: Official names, descriptions and grades are shown as PlayStation publishes them (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before this bounty opened; the two lists agree on every name, description and grade). Hidden flags follow the 27-visible / 28-hidden split those lists report. Every guide is written in the author's own words for this entry; where a step or location is not pinned down by a source, the guide says so plainly instead of inventing it. GTA 6 released 19 November 2026, so no complete walkthrough exists yet.

trophies.guide: The Platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly — it is the reward for finishing the whole list. Plan around it, not toward it: keep the roadmap's stages in order, do the one missable meditation in Chapter 1, and treat A Long Road (100% completion) as the last big gate before this one.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade (Platinum, not hidden). Roadmap order derived from the official descriptions.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through the early story until the mission Gone Fishing appears and finish it — the trophy pops when the mission completes. It is one of the hidden story trophies, so it stays concealed in your list until it pops; do not go looking for it in free roam, it only comes from the mission.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Guide derived from the official description; mission order not yet checked in-game.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end (chapter trophies can pop as the next chapter begins, so do not worry if it lands a beat late). Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing in this guide that can be missed: Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — see that trophy's guide.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Missable warning: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list (outputlag.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-list), checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 2 and it pops. Chapter 2 is where the list opens up: switching between Jason and Lucia becomes available, so most partner trophies and the Scooter Bros and Real Estate apps unlock from here on. Use the chapter to start the long grinds early — stunts, vehicle scanning and Challenges all count toward later trophies.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Partner/app unlock timing: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 3. This is the chapter where robbery tools arrive: the mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs hands you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies, which Sneakthief needs. Do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago the moment its hourglass icon appears — it belongs to a stranger strand that Strangers & Freaks counts.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Jewelry/Snap Gun and Yago race timing: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 4. Late in this chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens bank vaults, which Maximum Withdrawal needs — bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the bags alone, and escaping a vault with your partner also sets up Hot Together.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Bank vault unlock: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Gold story trophy, unmissable. Complete the final mission and it pops. Before you start it, keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission: the game has no mission replay, and that save is your safety net if anything in the finale goes wrong. After the credits, everything outside the story stays available, so the finale is a doorway to the cleanup stage, not the end of the list.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. No-mission-replay and manual-save advice: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Breakfast Run. The mission's name is all the official description gives, so the guide is short on purpose: follow the story until Breakfast Run appears, finish it, and the trophy pops. No side preparation is needed for it.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Guide derived from the official description; no further method confirmed at launch.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a named story mission, so it arrives in the natural order of the story — no free-roam setup unlocks it, and no choice in it is flagged as missable by any source checked.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Guide derived from the official description; no further method confirmed at launch.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, it pops when the mission ends, so the only work is reaching it in the story. Nothing in the official description asks for a specific approach, so play the mission however suits you.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Guide derived from the official description; no further method confirmed at launch.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Headliners. The name DWNFALL is the trophy's own title, not a hint about how the mission plays — the official description names the mission only, and that is all this guide claims. Finish Headliners and it pops.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Guide derived from the official description; no further method confirmed at launch.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The mission name ties it to the airport, which is also where the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can happens — but the two are separate unlocks, so do not expect this mission to pop the other one.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. VCIA link and Catch Me If You Can separation: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the six named-mission trophies in the hidden list; like the others it needs no preparation and pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Guide derived from the official description; no further method confirmed at launch.

trophies.guide: Gold, and the last big gate before the Platinum. Reach 100% completion — the in-game checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, which only appears after the story. Work you do earlier still counts, so do not wait: the checklist wants 300 stunts (past Cunning Stunts' 250), 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicle models, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. Once this pops, Vice Got a Price! follows immediately, so treat this as the finish line.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. 100% checklist counts (300 stunts, 70/80 Challenges, 200 vehicles, 8 vaults, 39 operations) and checklist location: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Silver. Complete 250 stunts — stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the total. Start early and let it build as you drive and fly through the story; the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 rather than stopping at the pop. Check your count under Progress so you know how far along you are.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Stunt types and the 300-for-100% count: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — the game's activities, from races and fishing to arcade games and the shooting range, one of each. You do not need to win or master any of them; one attempt at each type is enough for the pop. If it has not popped, open the activity list and look for a type you have never touched: the missing one is usually an activity you walked past, not one you failed.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Guide derived from the official description; the full activity list is not yet published.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver. Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — there should be two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: practice one challenge at a time, learn its scoring, and do not rush the set. It is one of the harder silvers, so leave it for the cleanup stage when you can focus on it without story missions interrupting.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Two ranges / 42 gold medals: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — there should be 14 drone race locations, and you need at least one win at each. Learn one location's course before moving on; a win anywhere counts, but only a win at a location you have not won at yet moves the counter. Check your progress after each race so you do not repeat a location you already won.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. 14 locations: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the operative word: winning the same race twenty times does not count, so work through the race list and tick off new ones. Street races, drone races and any other race type all feed the same goal, so mix them and let Earn Cash, Not Kudos build alongside Top Fun and the stranger racing strand.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Guide derived from the official description; race-type breakdown not yet confirmed in-game.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival, so find the fishing challenge he appears in and out-fish him — the trophy is about the challenge result, not about catching a particular fish. Fishing is also where the story mission Gone Fishing lives, so if you have done that mission you already know the fishing controls; the challenge itself is a separate event.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Guide derived from the official description; Cal's challenge location not yet confirmed at launch.

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish one, start to end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest or easiest one you find and play it through rather than sampling several. It is a small trophy, but it also ticks one activity type for Master of None, so do it while you are sweeping the activity list.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Guide derived from the official description; arcade locations not yet confirmed at launch.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Story-adjacent trophy, unmissable in the sense that it stays open after the credits. Complete the final mission of Andy's strand — the stranger mission line, not a main-story mission. Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks (it has its own trophy), so finish it on its own terms and check the strand's progress counter after each mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Andy's strand excluded from Strangers & Freaks: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand. Like the other side-character finales, it stays available after the story, so there is no rush — work through Kenton's missions when they appear and the trophy pops at the strand's end.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Guide derived from the official description; Kenton's mission list not yet published.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's strand. Billy's strand, like Andy's and Tyrone's, has its own trophy and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so do not be surprised when finishing it leaves that counter unchanged. The finale stays open after the credits.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Billy's strand excluded from Strangers & Freaks: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Not every optional questline counts: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies and do not count here, so you need eight others. Watch the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One warning: the Chapter 3 street-racing strand has a time-sensitive race, Race Against Yago, marked with an hourglass icon — do it the moment it appears, or that strand may be lost.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Excluded strands and the time-sensitive Yago race: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's strand. Randy is one of the five named side characters with a finale trophy; his strand ends with its own final mission, which pops this trophy. It stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Guide derived from the official description; Randy's mission list not yet published.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand. Tyrone's strand, like Andy's and Billy's, does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy. Finish the strand and this pops at its final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Tyrone's strand excluded from Strangers & Freaks: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable trophy — the only one several sources flag as possibly missable, so read this one first. Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. The trap is in Chapter 1: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time) — she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate. Follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and it is not confirmed that the trophy strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. There is no mission replay, so a manual save at the start of every chapter is your safety net.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Missable warning, balcony meditation timing and no-mission-replay: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list (also GTABase and PowerPyx, as cited there), checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks — a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which matters for the hunt's scoring. This is a hidden trophy, so its requirement stays concealed until it pops; follow Bret's strand and the unique-animal hunt is the strand's payoff.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Bret's Jason-only hunting questline and clean-shot advice: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Silver. Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — find the cards scattered across Leonida and finish three full sets. Cards are a pure collectible grind: explore thoroughly, and check your set progress so you know which sets are one card short. This is a cleanup-stage trophy; do not try to force it during the story, since card locations span the whole map.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Guide derived from the official description; card locations not yet mapped at launch.

trophies.guide: Silver. Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations across Leonida — WAiNK is the in-game photo/location app, and 'WAiNK It' means checking in at a place through it. This pairs naturally with exploration: every new place you visit is a chance to WAiNK it, so do it as you travel rather than as a separate sweep. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app also counts as discovering it for Whip It Good, so the two trophies feed each other.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. WAiNK vehicle-scan link to Whip It Good: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — the Challenges listed under Progress, Challenges. Many complete on their own while you play, so check the list early and see which ones you are already close to. The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80, so keep going past 50: this trophy is a milestone on the way to A Long Road, not a separate grind.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Challenge list location and 70-of-80 for 100%: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. You need Jason and Lucia together — call your partner in once switching is available (Chapter 2 onward). Then build a 4-star Wanted Level and lose it while your partner is still with you. The trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, so keep driving until the heat fully clears. A bank vault escape gives you a 4-star level straight away, so this pairs well with Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Partner requirement, heat-zone pop condition and vault pairing: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. Plan a route of three close shops in advance, and give the trophy a moment to pop after you leave the third shop (it can take about 30 seconds).
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Chain-break rule and pop delay: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive — the trophy builds passively if you make a habit of it. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100. Rare and parked vehicles count too, so check car parks and quiet streets, not just traffic.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. WAiNK scan counts as discovery; 200 of 277 for 100%: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a fight with a group of enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle so you can drop five before Focus runs out. Adrenaline extends Focus, so use it if you have it. If you only get four, reload and try a bigger group.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Combat Focus controls and Adrenaline tip: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — steal a plane and take off without a ticket. At VCIA, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge (planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count; the planes at gates E3 and E4 are reported to work). Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Boarding-bridge planes, gates E3/E4 and the 1 km delay: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not an instruction: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' means getting into a Rhino military tank. Tanks are reported parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops. The exact trigger is not spelled out by the official description, so treat the tank location as reported, not confirmed — if the tanks are not there, the trophy is still about getting into a Rhino, so keep looking for one.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Tank location (Mile Zero Air Station) reported, not confirmed: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is reported as a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on — detection fails the trophy.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Snap Gun method and Richardson target: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Silver. Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults, so keep robbing past five. Each vault escape gives you a 4-star Wanted Level, which also sets up Hot Together.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Vault unlock mission and 8-for-100% count: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo and get away before the police box you in. Like the other robbery trophies, it only pops once you have escaped — getting the money is half the trophy, losing the heat is the other half. It pairs naturally with the bank-vault and shop-robbery trophies in the same cleanup sweep.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Guide derived from the official description; truck spawn points not yet confirmed at launch.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every part of the map. This is the pure exploration trophy: drive, fly and walk into every corner until the whole map is uncovered. It pairs with You WAiNKer! (WAiNK each new place as you find it) and Whip It Good (scan new vehicles on the way), so do all three in one long exploration sweep after the story, when nothing is gating where you can go.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Guide derived from the official description; no region checklist published yet.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — one operation per gang, and there are nine gangs. Illegal operations are the gang-run fronts you can rob; Pest Control needs one from each of the nine. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way to that. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit so you do not rob the same gang twice and wonder why the counter is stuck.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description and grade. Nine gangs and 39 operations for 100%: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — say so plainly rather than inventing one. The official description is the whole clue: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The reasonable reading is a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach where you can order a cocktail, but no source checked has confirmed which spot or what triggers the pop. Try the beachfront bars, order a drink with a sea view, and check back once players map it — this guide will be wrong if it pretends the spot is known.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. No confirmed trigger: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026 ('Five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger yet').

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description points at a vehicle showroom and a 'classic style' escape — the obvious reading is driving a car out through a showroom's glass front — but no source checked has confirmed which showroom, which car, or what exactly counts. Do not waste money buying cars for it until a confirmed method appears; try a showroom smash in a cheap stolen car first and see if it pops.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. No confirmed trigger: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs, take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable; go back and finish the set.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Kingpin Bowling method and the three valuables: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — 'a partnership with mass appeal' — and the reported method is that it pops when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Treat the max-Strength reading as reported, not confirmed: it is the best-sourced explanation at launch, and if it does not pop, the trigger is something else about the partnership, not a grind you failed.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. Max-Strength reading reported, not confirmed: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: The description gives no action at all — 'choices made (for better or worse)' — and the reported reading is 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind if you play the list naturally. Do not chase it directly: check your Criminal Profile from time to time, and if it is close, a robbery sweep will finish it. If the 500-action figure turns out to be wrong, the fix is in the count, not the approach — keep playing criminally and it comes.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Official trophy list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for name, description, grade and hidden status. 500 Criminal Profile actions reported, not confirmed: Output Lag GTA 6 trophy list, checked 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on the second attempt — a retry, a rematch, a second try at a failed event — but no source checked has confirmed what. Do not grind blind for it: play the list, retry things you fail, and watch for the pop; the trigger will be mapped by players quickly, and guessing now would only waste your time.

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description — 'What the hell just happened?' — reads like a trophy for stumbling into something strange, an easter egg or a random event, rather than a task you can plan. Keep playing, keep your eyes open for the odd and unscripted, and check the community lists as they fill in.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by' suggests knocking people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat, not a gun — but no source checked has confirmed the target, the vehicle, or how many it takes. Try melee attacks from a slow-moving car at pedestrians only once a method is reported; until then, this is an unconfirmed reading, not a plan.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; launder them by selling them to your contacts. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so it builds across the whole game — do not try to earn it in one job. It pairs with Maximum Withdrawal and Pest Control, since the same robberies produce the bills you launder.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so it builds as you buy weapons, clothes, cars and food through the game. It pops on its own in a normal playthrough — if you are close near the end, buy the big-ticket items you actually want (a garage, a good car) rather than wasting money on junk for the counter.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count, so budget for all eight. Buy garages before you push On the Spot, since each registered car needs a free garage space.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (Little Boxes) and register cheap cars — there is no reason to register expensive ones for this trophy.
